scope: Independent narrow source review of the sole owned self-signed Code Signing fixture shape; no canonical/Git/cloud writes or behavior reruns.

reviewedSourceFacts.fact: The helper is the sole input shape, called once before any codesign. It generates one RSA2048 key and one SHA256 self-signed certificate; failure escapes through the unchanged run() nonzero guard. There is no CA-issued retry or ad-hoc/alternate signer.

A fixed public 277-byte req configuration is selected with -config and its unique owned_code_signing section. It contains one CA:FALSE basicConstraints, digitalSignature keyUsage and codeSigning EKU, plus SKI/AKI; no ambient v3_ca section or -addext duplication is used.

The P12 export uses the exact generated private key over stdin and the one certificate PEM, with no -certfile duplicate bag. Original random-password environment handling and private-stream suppression remain unchanged. This is source/command inspection, not an actual PKCS12 success.

leaf=root aliases the same actual DER. Both public PEMs are conversions of that DER; importer/reopen inputs, code identity SHA1, profile DeveloperCertificates SHA256, explicit policy anchor and profile CMS signer all derive from the same certificate/key.

The unchanged stored-identity check demands one real stored identity, exact leaf, root/leaf membership and actual matching-private-key challenge. Membership tests do not demand two distinct certificates; the unchanged C search still requires exact count1.

Explicit codeSign verification stays scoped to the supplied owned anchor with local/no-network options; codesign still selects the exact SHA1 and one owned Keychain. No global root/trust preferences/search-list operation is added; no codesign success is inferred from this separate policy check.

Both inner DER profile and outer plist CMS remain genuinely signed. The original four SDK-compiled main/extensions/framework binaries must all be signed; actual detached CMS is extracted from each produced signature and verified against its exact primary CD and owned anchor. The complete platform/CMS/archive/cleanup tail is byte-identical.

The unchanged verifier checks the actual SecKey signature, BasicX509 trust with explicit-only anchors, network disabled, chosen verification date, nonempty bounded chain, exact first signer hash and final anchor. A length1 controlled explicit-anchor chain is representable; no production Apple authorization policy is changed.

Both profile CMS layers remain independently verified. The actual SDK fixture loader passes its one supplied anchor to existing code/profile verification; replacement signing still uses the independent existing CA+leaf PKI fixture and Vault, retaining that chain coverage.
